The family program

The Wildwood Invitational Family Intervention (Wi-Fi) brings families into the weekly work. Not to assign blame, and not to stage a confrontation, but to build a clearer map of what this family has survived, where the patterns formed, and what support can realistically look like afterward.

It is invitational by design. Nobody is ambushed, and nobody is required to perform remorse. The work is structured, facilitated, and paced so that people can stay in the room.

Over the sessions we map three generations of a family's history: what each generation lived through, and how they met it. The point is to properly acknowledge the trauma a family has carried and to celebrate the resilience that got them through it, which is also how a person in recovery stops being the family problem and becomes a member of a family that has faced hard things before.

What families usually want to know

Can we be involved if the relationship is strained?

Usually yes, and strained is the norm rather than the exception. The program is designed for families who have already had the difficult years, for families carrying deep concerns, and equally for families who are getting along and want to stay that way.

What if we're the reason some of this happened?

That comes up often, in one form or another. The work is not an exercise in assigning fault. It is an attempt to understand how a family arrived where it is, which is the only useful starting point for changing anything.

What if they won't talk to us?

Then we start without them. Family sessions begin and continue whether or not the person you love takes part, so that the family can get on with its own work. We'll be honest with you about the pace.

Can I call before they've agreed to anything?

Yes. Many first conversations are with a parent, sibling or partner rather than the person who would be living here.

How to start

Book a consultation and tell us what's happening. We'll talk through where things stand, what kind of support would actually help, and whether Wildwood is the right fit. If it isn't, we'd rather point you somewhere better suited than admit someone who shouldn't be here.

Wildwood Farm provides extended sober living that is clinically and trauma informed, with leadership on site. Clinical services, including partial hospitalization and intensive outpatient care (PHP and IOP), are delivered through professional partners rather than on site.
